failure_semantics.unrecoverable_infeasible: solve exception, runtime error, non-finite control, invalid control dimension, out-of-bounds control, or simulator failure
failure_semantics.certificate_loss: no policy has a positive rollout certificate
failure_semantics.qp_infeasible: a certified policy exists but no candidate QP returns an accepted bounded input
failure_semantics.filter_failure: collision OR certificate_loss OR qp_infeasible; diagnostic only
failure_semantics.post_diagnostic_action: exact control returned by the selected baseline
